description: Hand-written art-direction patterns. Used as offline fallback when live inspiration is unavailable, and blended with InspirationCards otherwise. Each has token seeds (DESIGN.md-compatible), an imagery style, and when-to-use tags.

patterns.name: Editorial Serif
patterns.description: Magazine-grade layout: oversized serif display, generous margins, a strict baseline grid, restrained ink-on-paper palette with one accent.
patterns.imageryStyle: grainy editorial photography, natural light, muted film tones, lots of negative space

patterns.name: Swiss / International
patterns.description: Rigorous grid, Helvetica-like neo-grotesque, flush-left type, red accent, zero decoration. Order and clarity as the aesthetic.
patterns.imageryStyle: high-contrast black-and-white, geometric compositions, single accent color overlay

patterns.name: Neo-Brutalist
patterns.description: Hard borders, blocky cards, high-contrast primaries, visible structure, chunky shadows offset in one direction. Confident and loud.

tokenSeeds.typography: Chunky grotesque, heavy weights, mono for labels

patterns.imageryStyle: flat bold illustration, thick outlines, primary colors, no gradients

patterns.name: Organic Warm
patterns.description: Soft earthy palette, rounded forms, warm neutrals, hand-made feel. Approachable and human.

tokenSeeds.typography: Rounded humanist sans, warm serif for headings

patterns.imageryStyle: warm natural photography, terracotta and sage tones, soft daylight, artisan textures

patterns.name: Dark Luxe
patterns.description: Near-black canvas, gold or champagne accent, thin elegant type, wide letter-spacing, deep contrast. Premium and quiet.

tokenSeeds.typography: High-contrast serif display, thin sans body, wide tracking

patterns.imageryStyle: moody low-key photography, single warm light source, deep shadows, product on dark

patterns.name: Glassmorphism (done right)
patterns.description: Layered translucent surfaces over a soft mesh backdrop, subtle blur, restrained — one glass layer, not ten. Airy and modern.
patterns.imageryStyle: soft gradient mesh, abstract light refractions, no literal 3D blobs

patterns.name: Scandinavian Minimal
patterns.description: Cool off-whites, muted blue-grey, lots of whitespace, calm and functional, thin dividers.
patterns.imageryStyle: bright airy photography, natural materials, wood and linen, soft shadows

patterns.name: Cyber Neon
patterns.description: Deep space background, electric accents, mono type accents, subtle grid glow. Techy without being a cliché — restraint on the glow.
patterns.imageryStyle: dark tech photography, teal/violet rim light, circuitry macro, wireframe abstractions

patterns.name: Soft Pastel
patterns.description: Gentle candy palette, rounded everything, friendly and light, playful but tidy.
patterns.imageryStyle: soft pastel illustration, gentle gradients, cute rounded shapes

patterns.name: Corporate Trust
patterns.description: Confident navy + a single professional accent, structured cards, dependable and clean. B2B credibility.
patterns.imageryStyle: clean confident photography, real environments, blue-toned, no cheesy stock

patterns.name: Neo-Retro 70s
patterns.description: Warm mustard, rust and cream, groovy rounded slab type, arch shapes. Nostalgic and cozy.
patterns.imageryStyle: 70s film photography, warm grain, arch framing, earthy palette

patterns.name: Monospace Terminal
patterns.description: Developer aesthetic: monospace everywhere, dark or paper background, ASCII dividers, precise and honest.
patterns.imageryStyle: terminal screenshots, code, wireframe diagrams, no photography

patterns.name: Eco Natural
patterns.description: Forest greens and stone, recycled-paper texture, calm and grounded, sustainability signal without greenwashing clichés.
patterns.imageryStyle: natural outdoor photography, greenery, honest materials, soft daylight

patterns.name: Bold Pop
patterns.description: Saturated primary duo, giant type, energetic and youthful, big CTAs, motion-forward.
patterns.imageryStyle: high-energy photography, bold color blocking, dynamic crops

patterns.name: Art Deco
patterns.description: Symmetry, gold linework, deep emerald or navy, geometric ornament, elegant capitals. Timeless glamour.

tokenSeeds.typography: Elegant deco caps, refined serif body

patterns.imageryStyle: geometric gold linework, symmetrical ornament, rich jewel tones

patterns.name: Clinical Clean
patterns.description: Medical/health clarity: crisp white, calm teal, generous spacing, legible, reassuring and precise.
patterns.imageryStyle: bright clean photography, real people, soft teal tint, trustworthy

patterns.name: Vivid Gradient (tasteful)
patterns.description: One deliberate multi-stop gradient as a brand signature (not purple-to-blue), crisp white cards over it, modern SaaS energy — used sparingly.
patterns.imageryStyle: abstract vivid gradient hero, crisp product UI screenshots, no floating blobs

patterns.name: Playful Flat
patterns.description: Friendly flat illustration, cheerful secondary palette, rounded cards, approachable consumer tone.
patterns.imageryStyle: flat vector illustration, cheerful characters, simple shapes, warm palette
